company.name: Go2Films
company.profile: Jerusalem-based international distributor and world sales agent for Israeli and Jewish-interest cinema, handling documentary and fiction features plus shorts. Runs a large recurring circuit of Jewish film festivals, cultural institutions and embassies alongside international festival submissions.
